usage_note: Applies to listed equity shares sold on a recognised stock exchange where STT was paid on the sale (Section 111A short-term / Section 112A long-term). Not applicable to unlisted shares, debt, or off-market transfers, which follow different sections not modelled here. Holding period: long-term only if held for MORE than 12 months (Section 2(42A)), i.e. sold after the first anniversary of the buy date; tax.classify_term applies this calendar-exactly.

holding_period.note: Listed-equity LTCG requires a holding period of more than 12 months under Section 2(42A); unchanged throughout 2021-2026. threshold_days is informational only: classify_term compares the sell date with the buy date's first anniversary, so leap years are handled exactly.

stcg_111a.note: 15% STCG under Section 111A on STT-paid listed equity, the pre-Budget-2024 rate.
Budget 2024 raised STCG (Section 111A) from 15% to 20%, effective for transfers on or after 23-Jul-2024 (the Budget presentation date; Finance (No. 2) Act 2024).

ltcg_112a.note: 10% LTCG under Section 112A on gains above Rs 1,00,000/year, no indexation (Section 112A never allowed indexation for equity, unlike Section 112 for other assets) -- the pre-Budget-2024 rate.
Budget 2024 raised LTCG (Section 112A) from 10% to 12.5% and raised the annual exemption from Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 1,25,000, effective for transfers on or after 23-Jul-2024.

cess.note: Health & Education Cess at 4% of (income tax + surcharge), in force since Finance Act 2018 (FY2018-19); unchanged throughout 2021-2026. Applies to all assessees.

surcharge.description: Surcharge is set by the taxpayer's total income slab, but on Section 111A/112A gains (STT-paid listed equity) it may not exceed 15%. That cap has applied since FY2019-20 (Taxation Laws (Amendment) Act 2019 withdrew the enhanced 25%/37% surcharge for these gains); Finance Act 2022 extended the same cap to other capital gains, which this file does not model. Surcharge pct = min(slab pct, max_pct).

records.note: 15% CAP VERIFIED: PIB release (2019-08-24) withdrew the enhanced surcharge on 111A/112A gains from FY2019-20. SLAB THRESHOLDS UNVERIFIED this session (standard individual slabs: 10% over Rs 50 lakh, 15% over Rs 1 crore); with the cap, only the 10% and 15% slabs can bite. Marginal relief is not modelled.

loss_set_off_and_carry_forward.description: Not a fixed rate -- these are configurable ASSUMPTIONS the caller must set explicitly; the engine applies them mechanically and never invents a policy silently.
loss_set_off_and_carry_forward.note: Section 70/71/74: a short-term capital loss can be set off against both STCG and LTCG; a long-term capital loss can be set off only against LTCG; unabsorbed loss can be carried forward up to 8 assessment years, conditional on filing the loss-year return on time. These are the DEFAULT assumptions wired into tax.py's LossLedger; callers may override any of them, and every override must be recorded (never silently substituted).
